''Not to be confused with the [[Great Library]] of the [[White Tower]].''

{{quote|The TarValon.net Library is a part of the greater community of TarValon.net, and is run solely by members who volunteer their time. It is our goal to provide fans of Robert Jordan’s “The Wheel of Time” with accurate, comprehensible and extensive information on the series. It also serves our members with information on TarValon.net's history and as a base for our community group's headquarters.|Tar Valon Library homepage}}
